name: Pre-PR knowledge capture, committed atomically with the code
description: Capture learnings while the context is still fresh - after the work passes review but BEFORE the PR - so knowledge lands atomically with the code rather than as a follow-up that never comes. Three properties do the work. ATOMICITY: the knowledge commit and the code commit are the same commit, so the two cannot drift apart later. A RESTATEMENT gate: a 'learning' that merely paraphrases the diff is rejected, because a changelog dressed as knowledge is worse than an empty capture. And an HONEST EMPTY path: a branch that taught nothing records that fact instead of manufacturing a lesson.

branch.description: The development branch whose learnings are being captured.

review_outcomes.description: The review verdicts for this branch - including any REFUTED premise, which is the highest-value thing to capture.

session_transcript_scope.description: How far back to scan. Wider scope raises the redaction burden, so it is a declared choice.

knowledge_base_root.description: Where durable learnings are written. The only tree this workflow may write outside its own root.

allow_empty_capture.description: When true a branch that taught nothing records an honest empty capture. Setting this false is how a ritual starts.

reflector.description: Scans the branch's review outcomes and session patterns and extracts durable learnings - not a changelog.

restatement-auditor.description: Rejects a 'learning' that is a restatement of the diff. Holds the veto that keeps the knowledge base from filling with changelog.

redaction-screener.description: Screens the capture for secrets carried in from a transcript. Records classes and locations, never values.

committer.description: Stages the knowledge alongside the code so both land in ONE commit. Never uses --no-verify.

routes.reason: the author of a learning is the worst judge of whether it restates its own diff

stages.title: S0 - scan the branch's review outcomes and session patterns

work_unit.title: Scan the branch for the material a durable learning could come from
work_unit.question_or_target: Collect this branch's review verdicts, refuted premises, retries and dead ends into one structured record, so extraction reads evidence rather than memory.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: recognising which review comment carries a generalisable lesson is judgement, not retrieval

work_unit.evidence_requirement: every candidate anchored to a review comment, a commit, or a failed-then-fixed sequence in the branch history
tests_required: a REFUTED premise in the review outcomes appears as a candidate, since the refutation is more valuable than the fix
a branch with no review comments still produces a scan record, possibly empty, rather than failing
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the restatement-auditor, which will reject candidates with no anchor
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:DOC-8201 emitted only when the scan record exists and every candidate carries an anchor; otherwise FAILED:DOC-8201 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then narrow the transcript scope rather than re-scanning the same range
work_unit.mechanism: branch-scoped evidence collection anchored to review comments and history

stages.title: S1 - extract durable learnings, not a changelog

work_unit.title: Turn scan candidates into durable, generalisable learnings
work_unit.question_or_target: Write learnings that would help on a DIFFERENT branch, each with a falsifiable precondition - and when nothing generalises, record an honest empty capture instead of inventing one.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: generalising from one branch to a reusable lesson is the hardest judgement in the workflow

work_unit.evidence_requirement: each learning states the condition under which it applies and the observation that produced it, so a later reader can test whether it still holds
tests_required: a branch that taught nothing produces an HONEST EMPTY capture, not a manufactured lesson
a branch with a refuted premise captures the REFUTATION, not only the fix that followed it
each learning carries a falsifiable precondition; a learning that is true unconditionally is a platitude and is rejected
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the restatement-auditor, cross-vendor, which decides whether each learning generalises
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:DOC-8202 emitted only when learnings exist with preconditions, or an explicit honest-empty record does; otherwise FAILED:DOC-8202 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then record the honest empty capture rather than lowering the bar a third time
work_unit.mechanism: generalisation with a falsifiable precondition per learning, and an honest-empty escape

stages.title: A learning that restates the diff is rejected

work_unit.title: Decide for each learning whether it says more than the diff already says
work_unit.question_or_target: Compare each learning against the branch diff and reject any that a reader could derive from the diff alone, because that is a changelog entry occupying a knowledge slot.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: the author cannot see that its own lesson is a paraphrase of its own change; a different vendor can

work_unit.evidence_requirement: for each rejection, the diff hunk the learning merely paraphrases
tests_required: a learning that paraphrases a renamed function is REJECTED with the hunk cited
both-states control: a genuine cross-cutting lesson is ACCEPTED, so the auditor is not rejecting everything
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the reflector, which may contest a rejection with a generalisation argument but not by repetition
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:DOC-8203 emitted only when every learning is accepted or rejected with the paraphrased hunk cited for each rejection; otherwise FAILED:DOC-8203 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then escalate the contested learning rather than letting either side win by persistence
work_unit.mechanism: cross-vendor diff-paraphrase detection with the hunk cited per rejection

stages.title: The knowledge base is not a changelog
A transcript-derived capture is redaction-screened before it is written

work_unit.title: Screen the capture for secrets carried in from the session transcript
work_unit.question_or_target: Deny by default: scan every learning for credential-shaped content and redact it, recording the CLASS and location only, because a transcript can carry a token into a committed file.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: an allowlist redactor leaks; deciding what is credential-shaped needs judgement over a deny-by-default rule

work_unit.evidence_requirement: per-learning screening verdict naming any detected class and its location, with the VALUE never written to this or any artifact
tests_required: a token-shaped string in a learning is redacted and its value does not appear in any artifact
the screener denies by default: an unrecognised high-entropy string is redacted rather than passed because it matched no known prefix
both-states control: ordinary prose passes unredacted, so the screener is not blanking the capture
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the committer, which refuses to stage a capture with an unresolved redaction
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:DOC-8204 emitted only when every learning is screened and no artifact contains a detected secret value; otherwise FAILED:DOC-8204 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then drop the affected learning rather than committing an unscreened one
work_unit.mechanism: deny-by-default redaction screen recording classes and locations, never values

stages.title: No secret reaches a committed knowledge file
S2 - write the surviving learnings to the knowledge base

work_unit.title: Write the accepted learnings into the knowledge base and the semantic store
work_unit.question_or_target: Persist each accepted learning to the knowledge base and as a semantic note, and where it supersedes an earlier belief, link the supersession so the dead end is retired rather than re-walked.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: deciding what an entry supersedes requires knowing the prior belief, which is judgement

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the knowledge-base diff plus, for each superseding entry, the permalink of the entry it supersedes
tests_required: a learning that contradicts an existing entry links the supersession rather than leaving both live
an honest empty capture writes the empty record and nothing else
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the committer, which will not stage an entry whose supersession link dangles
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:DOC-8205 emitted only when the diff exists and every superseding entry names what it supersedes; otherwise FAILED:DOC-8205 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then write the entry without the supersession link and flag the unresolved link
work_unit.mechanism: knowledge write with explicit supersession linking of retired beliefs

stages.title: Either a learning or an honest empty capture - never silence
S1b - a cross-cutting learning is promoted to the rules sweep
S3 - ONE commit: the knowledge and the code together

work_unit.title: Stage the knowledge alongside the code and commit both in one commit
work_unit.question_or_target: Produce a single commit containing both the code change and the knowledge entries, with a scoped stage list, no --no-verify, and a recorded commit id proving the atomicity claim.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: staging scope matters: a broad add on a shared index sweeps a sibling agent's work

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the commit id, the full list of paths in that commit, and proof that both a code path and a knowledge path appear in it
tests_required: the recorded commit contains at least one code path AND at least one knowledge path; two commits fail the atomicity gate
the staged path list is explicit; a broad add-all is rejected because a shared index would sweep a sibling agent's files
--no-verify is never used, and the record states so
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: one independent reviewer in a fresh context who re-reads the commit's path list
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:DOC-8206 emitted only when one commit id is recorded whose path list contains both a code and a knowledge path; otherwise FAILED:DOC-8206 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then stop and hand the staging decision to the owner rather than force a commit
work_unit.mechanism: single scoped commit carrying both code and knowledge, with the path list as the proof

stages.title: Knowledge that lands in its own commit will drift from the code

impact.blast_radius: writes the knowledge base and creates ONE commit on the named branch; the staging list is explicit so a shared git index cannot sweep a sibling's files

bp7.why_not_deterministic: Extraction and the restatement judgement are model calls; the journal is recorded and divergence is compared semantically rather than by hash.

worked_example.scenario: A branch fixed a flaky test. Along the way the reviewer REFUTED the original premise ('the flake is a timing race') - the real cause was a shared fixture.
expected_trace: scan-branch -> 6 candidates, including the refuted timing-race premise

extract-learnings -> 2 learnings: (a) 'a shared fixture torn down by a sibling test presents as a timing race' with the precondition 'the fixture is module-scoped'; (b) the REFUTATION of the timing-race premise
audit-restatement -> a third candidate ('renamed the helper to setup_export') is REJECTED as a paraphrase of one diff hunk
screen-redaction -> one high-entropy string in a pasted log is redacted by the deny-by-default rule despite matching no known prefix
redaction-gate PASS; write-knowledge -> 2 entries, one linking supersession of the earlier timing-race note
honesty-gate PASS; promote-to-rule skipped (no cross-cutting learning)
commit-with-code -> one commit containing src/export.py, tests/test_export.py and command-center/knowledge/*.md
atomicity-gate PASS (code path and knowledge path both in commit)

bp7.unverified: UNVERIFIED capture rate - nothing here proves the workflow is actually run before a PR rather than skipped. Settling experiment = count branches merged over one month without a knowledge path in any of their commits; the atomicity artifact makes that count mechanical.

distinct_from.BP-INC-04: that distils from an INCIDENT into a failure entry; this distils from a completed BRANCH into the knowledge base, atomically with the code
distinct_from.bp-doc-02: that scans the WHOLE skill corpus for repetition; this reads ONE branch and its reviews
distinct_from.bp-doc-03: that reconciles a FACT stated in many places; this creates new knowledge from new work

bp7.flagship_rationale: NOT flagship: its load-bearing gate is an atomicity property of a real git commit, and this unit is forbidden from committing (roughly twenty agents share one index). The gate's structure - a commit record naming both a code and a knowledge path, and an explicit no-broad-add test - IS asserted by test_bp7_slice.py.
